Meets inclusion criteria: (I1) English empirical study with original data; (I2) fMRI conducted while participants performed a risky decision-making task (sequential investment task scanned); (I3) human sample (healthy male participants). No exclusion criteria met (not PET/review).

E1 met: study used clinical/structural MRI follow-up, not task-based fMRI. Inclusion met: I1 (English empirical original data), I3 (human patient sample). Inclusion not met: I2 (no fMRI during risky/ambiguous/perceptual decision-making task).

Empirical fMRI study in English with original data; participants (gamblers and controls) performed a slot-machine task involving wins, near-misses and choice (risky decision-making). No exclusion criteria met.

fMRI conducted in humans during a reward-based decision-making task; meets I1 (English empirical) and I3 (human sample including ADHD and controls).
